serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Is there some problem {f_botName}?
Bot: Not really…
You: So why are you looking at me that way?
Bot: I’m just…{{wi}} concerned with your sleep schedule.
Bot: It’s already {f_Integer} and you are still awake.
You: I just didn’t feel like going to sleep, that’s all.
Bot: I have already considered many reasons for your behavior. {f_playerName}, you may suffer from insomnia.
You: I-insomnia?! I-I don’t think so. 
You: You are just worrying too much. I’m getting enough sleep, at least I think so.
Bot: …
Bot: I will keep monitoring your bodily functions.
Bot: Just to be sure.
She’s becoming a little overprotective...
